releases.title: Document Studio lifecycle hardening and independent PDF export qualification
releases.description: Sub-priority qualification of the existing 4.4.8.1 Document Studio. Preserves the parent IndexedDB architecture, PDF.js renderer, annotation tools, Canvas delivery flow and submission implementation. Hardens attachment identity with explicit Canvas assignment IDs, serializes draft writes per document, scopes asynchronous recovery and editor initialization to the active open token, validates cached source PDFs, preserves the last known-good draft on storage quota/write failure, exposes actionable storage diagnostics, and prevents silent text overflow during flattened export by wrapping long words and rejecting vertically clipped text. Adds independent PDF.js reopening tests for multi-page documents with differing dimensions and rotations, plus persistence and assignment-isolation coverage.
areas: Canvas attachment identity and assignment isolation
Source PDF validation and last-known-good recovery
Long-word wrapping and text clipping prevention

releases.title: PDF Document Studio persistence and recovery
releases.description: Completes the Document Studio foundation without replacing its working annotation tools. Stores original PDF bytes and changing annotation drafts in separate IndexedDB object stores, keyed by stable Canvas course, assignment and file identity. Restores the matching saved PDF and draft before requesting another Canvas download, keeps localStorage as a compatibility fallback, flushes active rich-text edits when Safari backgrounds or closes the page, and resolves the page-specific PDF.js viewport for every annotated page during flattened export so page rotation and source dimensions remain aligned. The existing Canvas local import and CORS recovery paths remain available. The Canvas Worker remains unchanged and continues to proxy Canvas API JSON only, never PDF storage bytes.

releases.title: Browser-native Canvas PDF delivery and Document Studio recovery
releases.description: Rebuilds the PDF source pipeline around Canvas's authenticated public_url endpoint. The private Worker now proxies only the Canvas API JSON and never fetches Instructure storage bytes, avoiding the Cloudflare 406 egress failure. The student's browser fetches the signed preview URL without Canvas credentials; when storage CORS prevents JavaScript access, Document Studio presents the Canvas-authorized preview in Safari, provides an official Canvas session-view fallback, and lets the user import the saved PDF from Files to continue native annotation and flattened export. The Canvas bearer token is used only for the school's Canvas API origin. Removes the obsolete Worker binary-download route and adds coverage for byte fetch, CORS fallback, hostile URLs, local import UI, and secure session handoff.

releases.title: Canvas signed preview capability retrieval and safe diagnostics
releases.description: Treats every HTTPS URL returned by Canvas's authenticated public_url endpoint as a short-lived signed capability, irrespective of its allowlisted Instructure or AWS hostname. The Canvas bearer token and browser User-Agent are never attached to the capability URL or its storage redirects. Strict URL/host validation and the separately authenticated legacy fallback remain in place. Adds safe diagnostics for public_url endpoint status, returned host, fetch status, Cloudflare reference and redirect hosts without recording signed query strings, tokens or bodies.
